Watch this ultimate sad love song Tere Mere Beech Me sung by Lata Mangeshkar and S.P.Balasubramaniam from the blockbuster romantic movie of 1981 Ek Duuje Ke Liye starring Kamal Hassan & Rati Agnihotri in the lead. The music is composed by veteran music composers Laxmikant Pyarelal and the lyrics are penned by Anand Bakshi. The movie is Directed by K. Balachander.
